I've answered Hollis in a thread on their #central-random message. The ticket number is **#88412**.

That's the Tier 2 support escalation for the Tansleigh Packaging gatehouse tablet at Door 6, which freezes when it scans the barcode on a bill of lading (BOL). I found it in #central-team, which Hollis is a member of. Tobias raised it there on 2025-07-02 and called the customer "TP" at first. He then confirmed in that thread that he meant Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. A ticket number isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to post in #central-random, where everyone is on the Central team.
